limitations: A stopped lead near a crossing does not prove its purpose.

unresolved_judgment_calls: original marked or unmarked intersection crossing
lead stopped to permit pedestrian crossing
actual ego rear approach and overtaking pass

judgment_refs.phrase: stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection
judgment_refs.note: Original map and crossing review must establish the marked or unmarked intersection reference.

judgment_refs.phrase: to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway
judgment_refs.note: Lead rest and pedestrian proximity alone do not establish the purpose of the stop.

judgment_refs.phrase: any other vehicle approaching from the rear
judgment_refs.note: Original Native ego/lead directions and full bodies must establish rear approach.

judgment_refs.phrase: shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle
judgment_refs.note: Measure adjacent longitudinal overlap and getting ahead during crossing; do not infer legal outcome from a controller request.

sweep_specs.rationale: Original crossing, stop purpose and passing require review
